name: MonarchInboxRow
title: InboxRow
wrapsNative: HStack row content for a List row, with swipeActions(edge:allowsFullSwipe:) and TimelineView(.everyMinute); selection, the open-conversation highlight and edit-mode checkboxes come from List(selection:) and NavigationLink
summary: One conversation in an inbox list: avatar, name, compact age, a one-line preview, badges, an unread dot or count, and Mail's swipe actions.
whenToUse: As the row of a List of conversations, tickets or threads, inside a NavigationLink or a List with a selection.
whenNotToUse: Not for a notification feed item; use the notifications components. Not for a plain settings row; use a standard List row with LabeledContent.
api: init(_ title: String, preview: String? = nil, timestamp: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, avatarName: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, showsAvatar: Bool = true, systemImage: String? = nil, systemImageLabel: String? = nil, isUnread: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, unreadCount: Int? = nil, swipeActions: [MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction] = [], timeStyle: MonarchInboxRowTimeStyle = .compact, lineLimit: Int? = 1, labels: MonarchInboxRowLabels = MonarchInboxRowLabels(), @ViewBuilder badges: () -> Badges, @ViewBuilder trailing: () -> Trailing)

init(_ title: String, preview: String? = nil, timestamp: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, avatarName: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, showsAvatar: Bool = true, systemImage: String? = nil, systemImageLabel: String? = nil, isUnread: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, unreadCount: Int? = nil, swipeActions: [MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction] = [], timeStyle: MonarchInboxRowTimeStyle = .compact, lineLimit: Int? = 1, labels: MonarchInboxRowLabels = MonarchInboxRowLabels(), @ViewBuilder badges: () -> Badges) where Trailing == EmptyView

init(_ title: String, preview: String? = nil, timestamp: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, avatarName: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, showsAvatar: Bool = true, systemImage: String? = nil, systemImageLabel: String? = nil, isUnread: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, unreadCount: Int? = nil, swipeActions: [MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction] = [], timeStyle: MonarchInboxRowTimeStyle = .compact, lineLimit: Int? = 1, labels: MonarchInboxRowLabels = MonarchInboxRowLabels()) where Badges == EmptyView, Trailing == EmptyView
enum MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction { case toggleRead(@MainActor () -> Void), archive(@MainActor () -> Void), delete(@MainActor () -> Void) }
enum MonarchInboxRowAgeUnit { case now, minutes, hours, days, weeks }

MonarchInboxRowLabels.init(unread: (@Sendable (Int?) -> String)? = nil, age: (@Sendable (MonarchInboxRowAgeUnit, Int) -> String)? = nil, markRead: String? = nil, markUnread: String? = nil, archive: String? = nil, delete: String? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: Who or what the conversation is with.

options.name: preview
options.description: The latest message or a summary, on one line with an ellipsis.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: When the conversation last changed, as a compact age: now, 5m, 3h, 2d, 4w, then a short date.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the age. Without it the age follows the clock and updates every minute.

options.name: avatarName
options.description: The name for the avatar's initials; the title by default.

options.name: avatarURL
options.description: The avatar's picture, loaded with AsyncImage.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: A small SF Symbol after the title, such as the channel.

options.name: systemImageLabel
options.description: The spoken description of the symbol, such as "via email". Without it the symbol is decorative.

options.name: isUnread
options.description: Shows the unread dot and a bold title and age.

options.name: unreadCount
options.description: Shows a count instead of the dot, 99+ above 99. A count above zero makes the row unread.

options.name: swipeActions
options.description: Read or unread on the leading edge; archive and delete on the trailing edge. The first on each edge runs on a full swipe.

options.name: timeStyle
options.description: How the time is written: the compact age (5m, 3h, 2d, 4w, then a short date) or the full relative time (5 minutes ago, yesterday) by the shared relative-time rule, as the notification centre writes it.

options.name: lineLimit
options.description: The lines the title and the preview may take. One by default; nil shows them in full.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the spoken unread state, the age units and the swipe action titles.

options.name: badges
options.description: Markers on the last line: status, SLA, priority.

options.name: trailing
options.description: The end of the last line: a reference number, an assignee avatar.

options.name: isCurrent
options.description: Marks the conversation that is open beside the list: accent-tinted background and an accent bar on the leading edge.

states.name: read
states.description: Regular title, muted age, no mark.

states.name: unread
states.description: An accent dot before a bold title, and the age in the default text colour and semibold.

states.name: unread count
states.description: An accent capsule with the count, or 99+, at the end of the first line instead of the dot.

states.name: selected
states.description: The List's own selection highlight, and checkboxes in edit mode.

states.name: swiping
states.description: The system swipe actions with tinted buttons: info for read, accent for archive, danger for delete.

appearance: Title in the default text colour, preview and age in the muted text colour, the unread dot and count in the accent's solid colour with its on-solid text. Swipe actions are tinted with the info, accent and danger solid colours. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web row is a link with its own checkbox, long-press selection, current and keyboard-cursor states. On iOS opening, the open-conversation highlight, multi-selection in edit mode and keyboard focus come from List, NavigationLink and List(selection:), so the row does not draw them. Swipe actions follow Mail and have no web equivalent. Age units are overridable together through labels.age; the short date uses the view's locale and calendar.
accessibility: The row is one element read as the title, the unread state ("3 unread"), the channel, the full date and time, the preview, then the badges and trailing content.
The compact age is replaced by the full date and time for VoiceOver.
The unread dot and count are hidden; the state is spoken after the title, and shown by a bold title, so it does not depend on colour.
Swipe actions are also available as VoiceOver actions, named "Read" or "Unread", "Archive" and "Delete".
The avatar is decorative; a channel symbol is read only when it has a label.
The row is at least 44 points high and grows with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A time in the future reads as now.
Counts above 99 show 99+, while VoiceOver reads the exact number.
A count of zero with isUnread false is a read row.
Older than 30 days shows a short date, with the year when it is not the current year.
The title and preview are cut to one line each; badges and trailing content share the last line.
